scope: Corollary 6.9 of the manuscript “Baumslag-Solitar-free one-relator groups are hyperbolic” (preprints/Baumslag-Solitar-free-one-relator-groups-are-hyperbolic-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 258 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b578833682141115), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 40-41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The following assertions hold for the closed support Ω. 1. No line of Ω is carried by the small subgraph. There is an integer B0 such that every segment of a lift of an Ω-line to any of the selected subsequence cores Γn, if contained entirely in the small subgraph, has length at most B0. 40 2. Every endpoint of every line of Ω is irrational. 3. Every line of Ω lifts to each centered core union Γn and has a unique compatible bilateral trajectory. On each fixed window, the partial boundary transfer takes every support line in its domain to a line of Ω.
